fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: a mapped nested-model property is writable and its current value is null
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers prepares that property's mapping expressions via TryInstantiateMapToModel
fields.response: assign a new default instance of the property's type to the property
fields.postcondition: a non-writable nested-model property, or one that is already non-null, is left unmodified by this check
